column2: # Create the main map of Massachusetts with a Cividis discrete color palette
# Add the DEM raster layer using the discrete 'elevation_band'
aes(x = x, y = y, fill = band_index)) +
# Stepped colour bar guide: looks like a horizontal gradient strip
labels  = gsub("-", "\u2013", elevation_labels),  # add en dash to bands
na.value = "transparent",  # "transparent" to avoid showing NA pixels
# geom_sf(data = ma_boundary, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
pad_x = unit(0.2, "in"), # Padding from the edge
width_hint = 0.18,      # Relative width of the scale bar (30% of map width)
# subtitle = "Contour lines at 100m intervals (solid) and 50m intervals (dashed)",
fill = "Elevation Band (m)" # Update the legend title
